questions.question: The average of n observations is 40. If two observations 50 and 60 are added, then the average of all the observations will be 41. What is the value of n?
questions.solution:
**Given**

The average of n observations is 40

When two observations of 50 and 60 are added, then the average of all the observations will be 41

**Formula used**

Average = sum of observation/number of observation

**Calculation**

Let observation be n

⇒ Total sum of observation = 40n

⇒ After adding two observation new average = 41

⇒ Sum of new observation = (n + 2)&nbs

questions.question: When x is added each of 10, 23, 15 and 33, the sums obtained in this order are in proportion. The value of (x + 5) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are 10, 23, 15, and 33

x is added to each number and the sum is in proportion.

**Concept Used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion,

then, a/b = c/d

**Calculation:**

When x is added to each number the numbers will be,

(10 + x), (23 + x), (15 + x), and (33 + x)

⇒ (10 + x)/(23 + x) = (15 + x)/(33 + x)

⇒ (10 + x)(33 + x) = (15 + x)(23 + x)

⇒ 330 + 10x + 33x + x² = 345 + 15x + 23x + x²

⇒ 48x – 43x = 345 – 330

⇒ 5x = 15

⇒ x = 15/5

⇒ x = 3

The value of (x + 5)

⇒ 3 + 5

⇒ 8

**∴ The value of (x + 5) is 8.**

questions.question: A circle circumscribes a rectangle whose sides are in the ratio of 4 ∶ 3. If the area of the rectangle is 192 cm², then the perimeter (in cm) of the circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A circle circumscribes a rectangle whose sides are in the ratio of 4 ∶ 3. If the area of the rectangle is 192 cm².

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × Breadth

Perimeter of circle = 2πr

Radius = diameter/2

**Calculation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2b05087f7828c1e71e775c1d98f697f8fe634aecf0dacaa034e42391f4b2a05.png] 

Let the rectangle length(l) and breadth(b) be 4x and 3x

Area of rectangle = l × b

⇒ 4x × 3x = 192

⇒ 12x² = 192

⇒ x² = 16

⇒ x = 4

⇒ l = 4 × 4 = 16 cm

⇒ b = 4 × 3 = 12 cm

Diameter of rectangle = √(l² + b²)

⇒ √(16² + 12²)

⇒ 20 cm

When a circle is drawn out side the rectangle, diameter of circle is equal to diagonal of rectangle

Diameter of circle = 20 cm

⇒ Radius (r) = 20/2 = 10 cm

Perimeter of circle = 2πr

⇒ 2π × 10

⇒ 20π 

**∴ The perimeter (in cm) of the circle is 20π.**

questions.question: In a class of 88 students, the number of girls is 20% more than the number of boys. The average height of the boys is 164 cm, and the average height of girls is 4 cm less than the average height of all the boys and girls in the class. What is he average height (in cm) of all the students in the class?
questions.solution:

Total number of student = 88

The number of girls is 20% more than the number of boys.

The average height of the boys = 164 cm

The average height of girls is 4 cm less than the average height of all the boys and girls in the class.

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of total observations)/(total numbers of observation)

**Calculation:**

Let the number of boys be 'x'.

Again let the total average of the student be 'y'.

So, the average height of girls = y – 4

The number of girls = 20% more than the number of boys

⇒ The numbers of girls = x + 20% of x

⇒ x + (20x)/100

⇒ (6x/5)

According to the question,

Total numbers of student = 88

⇒ x + (6x/5) = 88

⇒ (11x/5) = 88

⇒ x = 40

So, the number of girls = 6x/5 = (6 × 40)/5 = 48

The number of boys = x = 40

(Sum of total observations) = Average × (total numbers of observation)

Sum of total height of student = y × 88 = 88y

Sum of total height of boys = 164 × 40 = 6560

Sum of total height of girls = (y – 4) × 48 = 48y – 192

Sum of total height of student = sum of total height of boys and girl

⇒ 88y = 6560 + 48y – 192

⇒ 40y = 6368

⇒ y = 159.2 

**∴ The average height of total student is 159.2.**

questions.question: A car travels for 11 hours. For the first 100 km, the car travels with a certain speed, and then it increases its speed by 15 km/h to cover the remaining 280 km. The time (in hours) it takes to travel the 100 km part is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Car travel for 11 hours.

First 100 km, he traveled at a certain speed,

Remaining 280km distance traveled by the increased speed by 15km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

ax² + bx + c = 0,

To solve the quadratic equation for bigger numbers,

Use for x = {b +/- √(b² – 4ac)}/2a

**Calculation:**

Time = Distance/Speed

A car traveled for 11 hours.

Let the initial speed of a car be x

⇒ 11 = 100/x + 280/(x + 15)

⇒ 11 = {100(x + 15) + 280x}/x(x + 15)

⇒ 11 = {100x + 1500 + 280x}/x² + 15x

⇒ 11(x² + 15x) = 380x + 1500 

⇒ 11x2 + 165x = 380x + 1500

⇒ 11x2 + 165x – 380x – 1500 = 0

⇒ 11x2 – 215x – 1500 = 0

Compairing with the quadratic equation ax2 + bx + c = 0,

we get,

a = 11, b = – 215, c = –1500

Using formula {–b +/- √(b2 – 4ac)}/2a

⇒ {–(– 215) +/- √(– 2152 – 4(11)(–1500))}/2(11)

⇒ {215 +/- √(46225 + 66,000)}/22

⇒ {215 +/- √1,12,225}/22

⇒ (215 +/- 335)/22

⇒ (215 + 335)/22 OR (215 – 335)/22

⇒ 550/22 OR –120/22

⇒ 25 OR –5.4545

Speed can not be negative

Initial speed of a car is 25km/hr.

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ 25 = 100/Time

⇒ Time = 100/25

⇒ Time = 4 hours.

**∴ Time taken by him to cover 100km distance is 4 hours.**

questions.question: A person an article at a loss of 8%. Had he sold it at a gain of 10.5%, he would have received Rs. 74 more. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person an article at a loss of 8%. Had he sold it at a gain of 10.5%, he would have received Rs. 74 more.

**Formula used:**

Selling price(S.P) = cost price(100 + profit%)/100

Selling price(S.P) = cost price(100 – loss%)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article be x

Selling price at 8% loss

Selling price(S.P) = cost price(100 – loss%)/100

⇒ S.P = x(100 – 8)/100

⇒ S.P = 0.92 x

Selling price at 10.5% profit

Selling price(S.P) = cost price(100 + profit%)/100

⇒ S.P = x(100 + 10.5)/100

⇒ S.P = 1.105 x

According to the question,

Person gets Rs. 74 due to his profit, cost price of the article is

⇒ 1.105 x – 0.92 x = 74

⇒ 0.185 x = 74

⇒ x = 74000/185

⇒ x = Rs. 400

**∴ The cost price (in Rs.) of the article is 400.**

questions.question: A 540 m long train, running at a uniform speed, crosses a platform in 55 seconds and crosses a man standing on the platform in 36 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Length of train = 540 m

Train cross platform in 55 sec and a man in 36 sec

**Formula used**

Speed = distance/time

**Calculation**

Let the length of platform be x m

⇒ Speed of train = 540/36

⇒ 15 m/sec

⇒ It cross platform in 55 sec

⇒ Train cover (540 + x) distance

⇒ Distance = speed × time

⇒ Distance = 15 × 55 = 825 m

⇒ x = 825 - 540 = 285 m

**∴ Length of platform is 285 m**

questions.question: A person invested a sum of Rs. 25,000 in two parts. First part at 10% per annum simple interest and the rest at 12% per annum simple interest. At the end of 2 years, the total interest received was Rs. 5,640. The difference (in Rs.) between the two parts of the sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Total invested = Rs. 25000

Two interest is 10% and 12%

Total interest = Rs. 5640

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = {Sum (P) × rate of interest (r) × time (t)}/100

**Calculation:**

Let the sum at 10% be x

Then the sum at 12% = (25000 – x)

S.I at 10% rate = 10 × x × 2/100 = x/5

S.I at 12% rate = 12 × (25000 – x) × 2/100

⇒ 6 × (25000 – x)/25

Total Simple interest = 5640

⇒ x/5 + [6 × (25000 – x)/25] = 5640

⇒ [5x + 150000 – 6x]/25 = 5640

⇒ -x + 150000 = 141000 

⇒ x = 9000

The sum lent at S.I rate 10% per annum is Rs. 9000.

And the sum lent at S.I rate 12% per annum is Rs. 16000.

So, the difference between them = 16000 – 9000 = Rs. 7000 

**∴ The difference between them is Rs. 7000.**

questions.question: Two persons A and B can complete a task in 10 days and 15 days, respectively. They work together and A leaves 5 days before the task is completed. The number of days taken to complete the whole task is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Two persons A and B can complete a task in 10 days and 15 days

**Concept used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

Efficiency = 1/time

**Calculation:**

Let both A and B worked for 'x' days.

A completes the work in 10 days.

In 1 day, A completes = 1/10 part of job.

B completes the work in 15 days.

In 1 day, B completes = 1/15 part of job.

Work done by A & B both in 1 day = (1/10) + (1/15)

⇒ (3 + 2)/(30) = 5/30 = 1/6

Work done by A and B in x day = x/6

Remaining work = 1 – x/6 ----(I)

The remaining work is done by B alone in 5 days.

In 5 days B complete the work = 1/3

So, Work done by B in 5 days = Remaining work

⇒ 1/3 = 1 – x/6 

⇒ x/6 = 1 – 1/3

⇒ x = 6 × (2/3)

⇒ x = 4

**∴ The total days to complete the work is 9 days.**

Total work is 30.

2x + 3(x – 5) = 30

⇒ 5x = 45
